fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM28,205. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0006181/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: At least FIVE (5) Credits at SPM level including in Bahasa Melayu and English OR an equivalent qualification recognized by MSU Senate All fees are in RM (Ringgit Malaysia) currency unless stated otherwise.
